description:
Search how a Danish politician/person voted in Folketinget afstemninger/stemmer. Use resolve_person
            first when only a name is known. Category filters should usually be omitted for initial searches and used
            only for refinement.

case_type_id.description: Related case type ID from the case type vocabulary resource.

category_id.description:
Advanced refinement filter. Use only when the user explicitly asks
        for this category or to narrow an already-inspected result set; categories are difficult to distinguish and
        should usually be omitted for initial searches.

from_date.description: Earliest afstemning date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

include_change_proposals.description: Include amendment/change proposal afstemninger. Defaults to false because change proposal vote casts do not describe what they changed.

person_id.description: Person ID. Use resolve_person first when only a name is known.

query.description: Free-text query for Danish case title.

to_date.description: Latest afstemning date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

vote_cast_type_id.description: Afstemning type ID from the vote event type vocabulary resource.

vote_type_id.description: Person vote type ID from the vote types vocabulary resource.

name: search_person_votes
